skill.name: Product Launch
skill.description: Orchestrates the announcement, assets, channels, and timing for shipping a product, covering the arc from teaser to launch day to post-launch momentum.
skill.summary: A 2-4 week arc, not a day: warm the waitlist first (converts 3-5x cold), teaser 3-7 days out, soft-launch 24-48h to break it, Day 1 as a 2-4h push, then a 2-week post-launch wave. One hero claim above the fold; activation over signups; D7/D30 retention is the real bar. Owned > earned > paid; paid amplifies only what already converts. Asset inventory and runbook are finite; ship the core.
